about: The Offertory for the Queenship of the Blessed Virgin Mary outside Eastertide in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Arisen from a royal lineage, Mary shines forth; with mind and spirit we most devoutly ask to be helped by her prayers.

ex.w010: The verb póscimus (“we beg”) comes at the end of the sentence. The request is that we be helped by Mary’s prayers.
